name: The Coffin of the Literature Club
source:
There's nothing more beautiful than two functional people in a healthy relationship. Communication, boundaries, respect... doesn't that sound nice? Well, if you said no, seek help. And then check this out!

We follow Natsuki as she starts to fall for Monika, and the many crippling fears that come with that. And, well, being forced to spend the foreseeable future together due to an unfortunate error on the school's part, there's never a moment where she's alone.

Will love heal or destroy? Can she tell the difference? Was it ever love in the first place? And... why are we summoning a demon now? Guys, I kind of lost track of time-- are-- are you SERIOUSLY drawing on the floor with blood? How in the world did you--

[From [url=https://www.reddit.com/r/DDLCMods/comments/1ph3q33/the_coffin_of_the_literature_club_episode_1/]Reddit[/url]]
